in_sanskrit.name: Arsad
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arsad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arsad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Arsha', meaning 'king' or 'lord'. The suffix 'd' is added, making the name signify the 'Lord of the Mountain'. This name is associated with strength, power, and a connection to nature.
